name: panel_store
description: Point-in-time panel of the all-fields day files: one row per (as_of, symbol) from each file's newest run inside the ingest floor, the move-prediction scores of the newest run before that scan, detected prints, forward labels and features. The study floor (signal_lab.json, alpha_model.json) is applied later on the as_of day, so a name that falls under it still has its later closes (no survivorship drop in the labels).

r_12_1.sql: CASE WHEN b.perf_y > -100 AND b.perf_1m > -100 THEN ((1 + b.perf_y / 100) / (1 + b.perf_1m / 100) - 1) * 100 END
r_12_1.label: 12-month return skipping the last month %

vs20.sql: CASE WHEN b.sma20 > 0 THEN (b.close / b.sma20 - 1) * 100 END
vs20.label: close vs SMA20 %

vs50.sql: CASE WHEN b.sma50 > 0 THEN (b.close / b.sma50 - 1) * 100 END
vs50.label: close vs SMA50 %

vs200.sql: CASE WHEN b.sma200 > 0 THEN (b.close / b.sma200 - 1) * 100 END
vs200.label: close vs SMA200 %

rng52.sql: CASE WHEN b.hi52 > b.lo52 THEN (b.close - b.lo52) / (b.hi52 - b.lo52) * 100 END
rng52.label: seat in the 52-week range, 0 = low

hi_prox.sql: CASE WHEN b.hi52 > 0 THEN (b.close / b.hi52 - 1) * 100 END
hi_prox.label: close vs 52-week high %

vol_trend.sql: CASE WHEN b.avgvol30 > 0 THEN (b.avgvol10 / b.avgvol30 - 1) * 100 END
vol_trend.label: 10-day vs 30-day average volume %

dollar_vol.sql: CASE WHEN b.avgvol30 > 0 AND b.close > 0 THEN ln(b.avgvol30 * b.close) END
dollar_vol.label: log 30-day dollar volume

size.sql: CASE WHEN b.mcap > 0 THEN ln(b.mcap) END
size.label: log market cap

ey_fwd.sql: CASE WHEN b.close > 0 THEN b.eps_nfy / b.close * 100 END
ey_fwd.label: next-FY EPS yield %

ey_ttm.sql: CASE WHEN b.close > 0 THEN b.eps_ttm / b.close * 100 END
ey_ttm.label: ttm EPS yield %

ebitda_yield.sql: CASE WHEN b.evebitda > 0 THEN 100 / b.evebitda END
ebitda_yield.label: EBITDA / EV %

sales_yield.sql: CASE WHEN b.evrev > 0 THEN 100 / b.evrev END
sales_yield.label: revenue / EV %

fcf_yield.sql: CASE WHEN b.mcap > 0 THEN b.fcf_ttm / b.mcap * 100 END
fcf_yield.label: FCF / market cap %

eps_nfy_g.sql: CASE WHEN b.eps_ttm > 0 AND b.eps_nfy > 0 THEN (b.eps_nfy / b.eps_ttm - 1) * 100 END
eps_nfy_g.label: next-FY EPS vs ttm %

rev_nfy_g.sql: CASE WHEN b.rev_ttm > 0 AND b.rev_nfy > 0 THEN (b.rev_nfy / b.rev_ttm - 1) * 100 END
rev_nfy_g.label: next-FY revenue vs ttm %

pt_up.sql: CASE WHEN b.close > 0 AND COALESCE(b.pt_1y, b.pt_avg) > 0 THEN (COALESCE(b.pt_1y, b.pt_avg) / b.close - 1) * 100 END
pt_up.label: street target upside %

pt_spread.sql: CASE WHEN b.pt_avg > 0 AND b.pt_high >= b.pt_low THEN (b.pt_high - b.pt_low) / b.pt_avg * 100 END
pt_spread.label: target high minus low, % of the average

rec_analyst.label: analyst rating mark (1 strong buy to 5 sell; ends 2026-10-13)

eps_rev_1m.sql: CASE WHEN m1.split_seq = b.split_seq AND b.as_of - m1.as_of <= 30 + {lag_tol} AND m1.eps_nfy > 0 AND b.eps_nfy > 0 THEN (b.eps_nfy / m1.eps_nfy - 1) * 100 END
eps_rev_1m.label: next-FY EPS estimate change over 1 month %

eps_rev_3m.sql: CASE WHEN m3.split_seq = b.split_seq AND b.as_of - m3.as_of <= 91 + {lag_tol} AND m3.eps_nfy > 0 AND b.eps_nfy > 0 THEN (b.eps_nfy / m3.eps_nfy - 1) * 100 END
eps_rev_3m.label: next-FY EPS estimate change over 3 months %

rev_rev_1m.sql: CASE WHEN b.as_of - m1.as_of <= 30 + {lag_tol} AND m1.rev_nfy > 0 AND b.rev_nfy > 0 THEN (b.rev_nfy / m1.rev_nfy - 1) * 100 END
rev_rev_1m.label: next-FY revenue estimate change over 1 month %

rev_rev_3m.sql: CASE WHEN b.as_of - m3.as_of <= 91 + {lag_tol} AND m3.rev_nfy > 0 AND b.rev_nfy > 0 THEN (b.rev_nfy / m3.rev_nfy - 1) * 100 END
rev_rev_3m.label: next-FY revenue estimate change over 3 months %

pt_rev_1m.sql: CASE WHEN m1.split_seq = b.split_seq AND b.as_of - m1.as_of <= 30 + {lag_tol} AND COALESCE(m1.pt_1y, m1.pt_avg) > 0 AND COALESCE(b.pt_1y, b.pt_avg) > 0 THEN (COALESCE(b.pt_1y, b.pt_avg) / COALESCE(m1.pt_1y, m1.pt_avg) - 1) * 100 END
pt_rev_1m.label: street target change over 1 month %

rev_surprise.sql: COALESCE(CASE WHEN b.rev_est_last_q > 0 AND b.rev_last_q > 0 THEN (b.rev_last_q / b.rev_est_last_q - 1) * 100 END, b.rev_surprise_tv)
rev_surprise.label: last print revenue surprise %

eps_q_step.sql: CASE WHEN b.eps_last_q > 0 AND b.eps_next_q IS NOT NULL THEN (b.eps_next_q / b.eps_last_q - 1) * 100 END
eps_q_step.label: coming-quarter EPS estimate vs last quarter %

rev_q_step.sql: CASE WHEN b.rev_last_q > 0 AND b.rev_next_q > 0 THEN (b.rev_next_q / b.rev_last_q - 1) * 100 END
rev_q_step.label: coming-quarter revenue estimate vs last quarter %

dsp.sql: CASE WHEN b.earn_last > 0 THEN b.as_of - CAST(to_timestamp(b.earn_last) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE) END
dsp.label: days since the last print

dte.sql: CASE WHEN b.earn_next > 0 THEN CAST(to_timestamp(b.earn_next) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE) - b.as_of END
dte.label: days to the next print

react_last.sql: CASE WHEN b.as_of - pr.react_file <= 120 THEN pr.react END
react_last.label: last print reaction-day change %

since_print.sql: CASE WHEN b.as_of - pr.react_file <= 120 AND pr.split_seq = b.split_seq AND pr.react_close > 0 THEN (b.close / pr.react_close - 1) * 100 END
since_print.label: close vs the last reaction close %
